full_judgment: 4. Defendant No. 2 contested the suit denying the material facts made in the plaint contending, inter alia, that during continuance of the right, title and possession of Krishnalal Karmakar having 10 annas share and Priyanath Karmakar having 6 annas share, one Manager for the Syedpur Trust Estate purchased their shares in auction for failure to pay Government rent and took possession after giving proper notice to them. On 30.01.1954 defendant No. 2 took settlement of 63 decimals of land from Syedpur Trust Estate when the said land was proposed for giving settlement and on the same day the defendant No. 2 executed a kabuliyat in favour of the owner who accepted the kabuliyat and since then defendant No. 2 has been possessing the suit land by obtaining Dakhilas on payment of rent. At first the record of said .63 acre of land was prepared in the name of defendant No. 2, but later the same was wrongly recorded and published in the S.A. Khatian No. 1 in the name of the Government. The eldest son of defendant No. 2 Arabinda has been residing in the suit land by erecting dwelling but thereon and that the plaintiff has no right, title and possession in the suit land in any side. Hence, the instant suit is liable to be dismissed with cost.
